answer: Cap trust across a cut and clone farms stop scaling. One vertex is one agent; a component pushes at most six units per epoch, no matter its size. Weight needs endorsements from three separate components, each a cipher seal tied to that vertex, unreplayable onto clones. Auditors check each epoch; farming components lose six units and fall into the tundra, flow frozen until readmission. One honest vertex earns one unit; a hundred clones earn six. A hundred units need seventeen components at $300 and thirty days each, about $5,100 and 510 days. A farm is a crowded room with one door.
